nodes.label: Favicon (Vite Lightning Bolt Logo)
nodes.rationale: 48x46 SVG of a purple (#863bff) lightning-bolt shape with masked, blurred ellipse glows in violet (#7e14ff), lavender (#ede6ff) and cyan (#47bfff) using display-p3 colors; this is the default Vite scaffold favicon, not yet replaced with Horario branding.
